include: currently listed common stocks on TWSE
currently OTC-listed common stocks on TPEx

historical_prices.applies_to: securities in the current eligible TWSE and TPEx universe
historical_prices.requirement: download historical daily OHLCV for eligible securities across the five-year lookback where official source data is available
historical_prices.missing_data_policy: do not impute; record unavailable or unverified coverage

notes: This scope intentionally excludes securities that are no longer listed or OTC-listed as of the current universe snapshot.
Historical five-year prices are still required for eligible securities; this does not mean downloading only current-day quotes.
Current universe snapshots must be refreshed and dated before each production ingestion run.
The active-only scope is a phase-one simplification and can be expanded in a later phase.
